The player must first locate a smoker (a kitchen/cooking block) which serves as a landmark indicating a food preparation area. Near the smoker, stone slabs will be placed as part of a kitchen floor/counter structure that the player must mine to access a hidden chest or area containing a mushroom stew. Finally, the player must eat the mushroom stew to complete the sequence. This creates a logical narrative: find the kitchen (smoker) → break through the stone slab barrier/floor → retrieve and eat the mushroom stew. Each task builds naturally on the previous one without requiring deep Minecraft crafting knowledge.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate into the kitchen building and look at the smoker block placed at spawn-relative [6, 0, 9]. A max_distance of 5 ensures the player is inside the kitchen, and facing_tolerance of 60° confirms they are looking toward the smoker.

Uses inventory_has because mining a stone slab with a pickaxe causes it to drop as an item into the player's inventory. The player starts with zero stone slabs, so having ≥1 confirms successful mining of the blocking slab.

Uses inventory_has with item='bowl' because eating mushroom stew always produces exactly 1 bowl as a byproduct. The player starts with no bowls and there is no other source of bowls in the scene, making this a definitive proof of consumption.

The chest is blocked by a stone slab placed on top of it. The player spawns with a stone pickaxe to mine the slab. The kitchen has an open doorway for easy entry.
task_text: Enter the kitchen building ahead. Find the smoker inside. Mine the stone slab blocking the chest to retrieve and eat the mushroom stew.
